description: Karen Martin, candidate for State Representative District 99 representing East Haven, has received the endorsement of the Working Families Party (WFP) and will appear on an additional line for the upcoming election ballot. Securing this additional ballot line provides voters with a clear opportunity to support Martin's vision for working-class families. The endorsement highlights a platform focused on economic relief, fair wages, and policy initiatives

title: Karen Earns Working Families Party Endorsement!
